stories.title: Attacchi russi su Kiev e Zaporizhzhia. Usa: 400 milioni per Kiev, ma senza i Patriot

en.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia. USA: 400 million for Kyiv, but without Patriot
en.summary: Russia launched attacks on Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia while the United States announced 400 million in aid to Ukraine without Patriot systems. Reports suggest Trump requested Zelensky meet in Moscow, which Kyiv denied, and Putin indicated willingness to resume negotiations if Ukraine halts operations.

stories.title: Svolta Garlasco, Garofano dai Pm a due giorni dalla chiusura indagini

en.title: Garlasco breakthrough: Garofano meets with prosecutors two days before investigation closure
en.summary: Prosecutors interviewed General Luciano Garofano and RIS officers who investigated the 2007 murder of Chiara Poggi, just before closing their investigation. Details of the meetings remain confidential.

stories.title: Gli U2 tornano nel loro liceo di Dublino per festeggiare i 50 anni di carriera

en.title: U2 returns to their Dublin high school to celebrate 50 years of career
en.summary: The Irish band U2 returned to Mount Temple school, where the group formed in 1976, to perform a mini-concert for students as part of their 50-year career celebration.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, a sorpresa Garofano in Procura: accelerazione finale sui rilievi del 2007. Le novità

en.title: Garlasco case: Garofano unexpectedly visits prosecutor's office in final acceleration on 2007 findings. Updates
en.summary: A prosecutor's office meeting with General Garofano represents a final push on 2007 forensic findings in the Garlasco case, with a September 28 deadline approaching for judges to decide on trial proceedings. Four reports have been submitted to strengthen the prosecution's case.

stories.title: Accuse di creare dipendenza nei giovani, TikTok patteggia in Alabama e paga 100 milioni di dollari

en.title: TikTok settles addiction allegations in Alabama, pays 100 million dollars
en.summary: TikTok reached a settlement in Alabama over accusations of creating addiction in young users, paying 100 million dollars with potential increases to 300 million. The platform must implement a 2-hour daily limit, nighttime access restrictions, and parental notifications.

stories.title: Media, intelligence egiziana aveva avvertito Israele prima del 7 ottobre

en.title: Media: Egyptian intelligence warned Israel before October 7
en.summary: Egyptian intelligence reportedly alerted Israel before the October 7 attacks, with an official recommending that concessions be granted to Hamas.

stories.title: Gli U2 per i loro 50 anni di carriera tornano nella scuola dove tutto è cominciato

en.title: U2 returns to school where their career began for 50th anniversary
en.summary: U2 performed a concert in the courtyard of the school where their career started, playing for roughly a thousand music students benefiting from the band's legacy.

stories.title: TikTok patteggia in Alabama le accuse di creare dipendenza nei giovani

en.title: TikTok settles addiction accusations in Alabama
en.summary: TikTok reached a settlement over allegations of creating addiction in young users, paying 100 million dollars with the amount potentially rising to 300 million.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, news di oggi. 7 ottobre, “l’Egitto aveva avvertito Netanyahu”

en.title: War in Iran, news today. October 7, "Egypt had warned Netanyahu"
en.summary: Egypt reportedly warned Netanyahu before October 7. Trump rejected an agreement while mediators discussed Iranian proposals, with new attacks potentially following midterm elections.

stories.title: Nations League: l'Italia parte male, il Belgio vince 2-0

en.title: Nations League: Italy starts poorly, Belgium wins 2-0
en.summary: Belgium defeated Italy 2-0 with goals from Godts and Lukebakio in a Nations League match, putting Italy in a difficult position early in the competition.

stories.title: A Zelensky l’ok di Trump per i Patriot, ma Putin frena sui negoziati: “Colpa degli attacchi di Kiev”

en.title: Zelensky gets Trump's approval for Patriot, but Putin slows negotiations: "Fault of Kiev's attacks"
en.summary: Trump approved Patriot systems for Zelensky while Putin stated Russia is not waging war on Europe and blamed Ukrainian attacks for halting peace talks.

stories.title: Garlasco, Garofano sentito dai pm prima della chiusura indagini: focus sugli accertamenti del 2007

en.title: Garlasco, Garofano questioned by prosecutors before investigation closure: focus on 2007 findings
en.summary: Days before closing an investigation, prosecutors in Pavia re-examined scientific assessments from 2007, questioning a former RIS commander and officers, with further expert reports on Sempio expected.

stories.title: Caputi: «Trasformare l’attrattività dell’Italia in ricchezza diffusa»

en.title: Caputi: "Transform Italy's attractiveness into widespread wealth"
en.summary: An end-of-term agreement with the government includes a simplification decree to convert Italy's appeal into broader economic benefits.

stories.title: Fondi UE, il rischio di fare bene le cose sbagliate: la riforma che cambia le regole di valutazione dal 2028

en.title: EU Funds, the risk of doing well the wrong things: the reform that changes evaluation rules from 2028
en.summary: European Union fund evaluation methods are being reformed, changing how results are measured, counted, and verified starting in 2028. The reform is among several policy matters under discussion in Brussels for the upcoming budget cycle.

stories.title: Grimaldi: «Investiremo 3 miliardi sulle navi del futuro»

en.title: Grimaldi: "We will invest 3 billion on ships of the future"
en.summary: Grimaldi announces a 3 billion investment in future ship development. The company reports solid results in 2025 despite a challenging economic environment.

stories.title: In Calabria, Sardegna e Sicilia i primi treni a idrogeno a scartamento ridotto al mondo

en.title: In Calabria, Sardinia and Sicily the world's first narrow-gauge hydrogen trains
en.summary: Swiss company Stadler has manufactured 21 hydrogen-powered trains for three Italian regional operators: 10 for Sardinian regional transport, 9 for Calabrian railways, and 2 for Sicilian Circumetnea railway.

stories.title: Sui costruttori la scure degli extra-costi

en.title: Construction companies face the burden of extra costs
en.summary: Construction industry representatives report that material costs including concrete, plastic, bitumen, and electrical cables continue rising, eroding profits and reducing available liquidity.
